metaTitle: Restoration Marketing for Water, Fire and Mold Work
metaDescription: Restoration marketing from ASP: get found when water, fire or mold damage hits and see which channel booked each job. You own every account.

hero.h1: Restoration Marketing for the Moment Damage Hits
hero.subhead: When water, fire or mold damage hits, ASP works to make your company easy to find with local search, water damage Local Services Ads and storm-timed content.
points: Calls traced to booked restoration jobs
StormFront content timed to weather events

why.heading: Why restoration marketing runs on urgency
why.intro: Restoration work starts with damage, and water damage can't wait. Your marketing has to put your company in front of the owner while they are still choosing who to call.

cards.title: A 24-to-48-hour window
cards.body: EPA advises drying water-damaged areas and items within 24 to 48 hours to prevent mold growth. That leaves owners little time to compare companies.

cards.title: Some demand follows the weather
cards.body: In markets touched by the Atlantic hurricane season, it runs June 1 to November 30, with most activity mid-August to mid-October. StormFront publishes targeted content when qualifying weather events hit.

cards.title: When owners call a pro
cards.body: EPA advises calling a professional after sewage or other contaminated-water damage, and tells people hiring for mold to check experience and references. Your pages should answer that first.

services.heading: What ASP runs for restoration companies
services.intro: Each service is set up around water, fire and mold work and reports into one booked-job view.

cards.title: Restoration SEO
cards.body: Separate pages for water damage, mold remediation and fire and smoke damage, each naming the IICRC standard you follow: S500, S520 or S700.

cards.title: Google Ads and LSA
cards.body: Water damage services is a Local Services Ads category in the US. As of October 2026, fire, smoke and mold-only work runs on Search Ads, split by service.

cards.title: StormFront content
cards.body: Weather-triggered posts drafted, published and indexed when water or storm damage events hit your service area.

cards.title: Business Profile and maps
cards.body: Profile management, citation cleanup and a monthly ranking heatmap, with a service area set up to fit Google's guidelines.

cards.title: Meta for name recognition
cards.body: Emergency calls come from search, so Meta builds familiarity in your area beforehand and brings back people who visited your site.

cards.title: Call tracking to revenue
cards.body: Each source gets its own tracked number, forms carry campaign tags, and lead source flows into your CRM wherever it supports that.

steps.body: Your monthly report ties calls and forms to booked restoration jobs and the revenue they brought in.

pricing.heading: Packages for restoration companies
pricing.subhead: Organic SEO is included from Foundation up. Paid media management, which runs your water damage LSA and Search Ads, is included from Growth up.

faqs.question: What does a restoration marketing agency do?
faqs.answer: It gets a water, fire or mold restoration company found when damage happens and shows which channels produced booked jobs. ASP runs local search, service pages, Local Services Ads, Search Ads, Meta and StormFront content, with call tracking tied to your CRM.

faqs.question: Can I advertise fire and mold work on Local Services Ads?
faqs.answer: As of October 15, 2026, Google's US list had no separate fire and smoke or mold-only category. The water damage category's description does mention mold. Fire and mold work beyond that runs on Google Search Ads with its own ad groups.

faqs.question: How does StormFront help a restoration company?
faqs.answer: StormFront watches your service area and publishes targeted content when qualifying weather events hit, including water and storm damage events. The content is timed to the spike in search that follows.

faqs.question: Who owns my Business Profile and ad accounts?
faqs.answer: You do. You stay the primary owner of your Business Profile, and ASP works inside it as a manager you can remove. Your ad accounts are in your name too, and nothing costs an exit fee to hand back.

cta.heading: Be easy to find when damage hits
cta.body: Tell us your service area and which jobs you want more of: water, fire or mold. We'll look at your current setup and point out what we would fix first.
